_doc: Example runtime status file for the ISO builder. This file is updated by the watcher.
_status: --- BUILD PROCESS FIELDS (written by the builder, do not edit) ---
_started: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the current or last build started.
_finished: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the last build completed (successfully or not).
_source_hash: SHA-256 of the x86_64/x86_64.bu file used for the last build. The builder uses this to detect whether the source has changed since the last successful build.
_fcos_version: The FCOS version string (e.g. 42.20250601.3.0) of the base ISO used for the last build.
_error: Human-readable failure reason. Only present when status is failed. See build.log in the same directory for full output.
